body.name: \(\mathscr B_{n,\alpha}\)
body.construction: Set \(\tau_n=\epsilon_n^2\).  Use Taylor--Legendre enclosures of order at most a fixed multiple of \(K_n\) for the compactly supported latent density and marked density transforms, with the multiple chosen so that their exponential Taylor remainders on \(\mathcal C_*\) are at most \(\tau_n\).  Truncate each error law at radius proportional to \(\tau_n^{-1/2}\) using its second-moment tail envelope and enclose the truncated transform by positive atomic quadrature and Taylor order proportional to \(\tau_n^{-1/2}\).  Enumerate rational finite-law witnesses consisting of rational stratum masses, certified spline density and marked-density pieces, positive rational error quadratures and tail bounds, and a bounded Bernoulli potential-outcome schedule.  Outward-rounded Bernstein branch-and-bound produces rational boxes \(b\).  A box is retained in \(\mathscr B_{n,\alpha}\) only if it carries a finite certificate for one such witness law in its prospective decoder, its recorded interval encloses \(\{\mathscr D_n(Q):Q\in\operatorname{Dec}_n(b)\}\), that interval has radius at most \(\tau_n\) and lower endpoint at most \(\epsilon_n^2\), and all endpoint coordinate and remainder enclosures used below have radius at most \(\zeta_n\).  Boxes failing the witness, model-membership, or constraint tests are discarded.  All enumeration, subdivision, comparisons, and tie breaking use a fixed deterministic rational ordering.
